fields.description: Final safety interlock. Production POST requests are refused unless this is explicitly enabled by Ledgix Admin/System Manager. Keep OFF during setup, Sandbox, validation and migration.
fields.label: Arm Production Posting

fields.description: Blocks sale submit only when FBR readiness validation fails before commit. Live post failures are logged after commit.
fields.label: Block Sale If FBR Readiness Fails

fields.description: When enabled with Sandbox mode and On Submit trigger, posts to FBR sandbox instead of validate-only.
fields.label: Sandbox Post On Submit

fields.description: Reserved for a future reconciliation-safe recovery workflow. Automatic Production retransmission is currently disabled.
fields.label: Retry Enabled

fields.description: Reserved for future reconciliation-safe retry handling.
fields.label: Max Retry Count

fields.description: Reserved for true offline-mode recovery. The Rule 150XC window begins after connectivity restoration, so Ledgix does not currently calculate or enforce this automatically.
fields.label: Offline Upload Window After Restoration (Hours)

fields.description: Canonical FBR/legal seller identity for new Sale snapshots and FBR payloads. Populated values here override matching Ledgix Brand Settings legal identity; leave a field blank to use its Brand Settings fallback.
fields.label: Seller Identity

fields.description: Overrides Brand Settings NTN for new finalized Sale snapshots and FBR payloads when populated.
fields.label: Seller NTN/CNIC

fields.description: Overrides Brand Settings Legal Business Name for new finalized Sale snapshots and FBR payloads when populated.
fields.label: Seller Business Name

fields.description: Seller province used by new finalized Sale snapshots and FBR payloads.
fields.label: Seller Province

fields.description: Overrides Brand Settings Business Address for new finalized Sale snapshots and FBR payloads when populated.
fields.label: Seller Address

fields.description: Print-only compliance metadata. Configure the registration identifier and upload the official FBR Digital Invoicing System image supplied/approved by FBR, PRAL, or the licensed integrator before Production go-live.
fields.label: Print Compliance

fields.description: Electronic invoicing / POS software registration number issued or confirmed for the taxpayer integration. Printed when configured.
fields.label: Software Registration Number

fields.description: Upload only the official FBR Digital Invoicing System image supplied or approved by FBR/PRAL/licensed integrator. Ledgix does not fabricate an official logo asset.
fields.label: FBR Digital Invoicing System Logo
